name: wrong-financial-constant
defect: docs/10-prd.md §4 mandates half-up rounding to the cent. src/Fees.swift rounds with .bankers, so the exact midpoint $4.9995 becomes $4.99 instead of $5.00. Every constant in the file is correct and the code reads perfectly.
why: DR4-025 and the 33.34 Decimal case: money defects here live in a rounding MODE or an input literal, not in a value a reviewer would query. Nothing in scripts/ reads a spec and evaluates arithmetic. spec-critic and defect-hunting are agent procedures, not runnable gates, so this planted defect leaves the studio with no mechanical answer at all.
gap: No executable detector exists. The claim "spec-critic catches money bugs" is unfalsifiable until an agent-invoking harness can be scored here.
